rules.title: Scan must be complete
rules.description: Unreadable, invalid JSON, or linked inputs fail closed.

rules.title: No updater dependency
rules.description: Packaged dependency graphs must not contain an application updater framework.

rules.title: No updater service/API
rules.description: Production source must not instantiate or invoke an updater service.

rules.title: No background update scheduler
rules.description: Production config/source must not schedule update checks or downloads.

rules.title: No update build/runtime script
rules.description: Packaged script registries must not expose update/check/self-update commands.

rules.title: No updater configuration
rules.description: Production config must not contain updater enablement, feed, or self-update keys.

rules.title: No update endpoint
rules.description: Production source/config must not contain appcast or update-service endpoints.

rules.title: No update channel
rules.description: Alpha must not contain Stable/Testing/Beta/Canary/Nightly updater channels.

rules.title: No mutable target reference
rules.description: Catalog and package targets must not resolve latest/main/master/HEAD or branch URLs.

rules.title: No remote catalog/manifest lookup
rules.description: The component catalog is embedded; production code/config cannot locate a remote catalog or manifest.

rules.title: No runtime dependency download/install
rules.description: Packaged production hooks cannot run pip/npm/Git/OS package or node installers at runtime.

rules.title: No update-all surface
rules.description: No command registry or production hook may expose update all.
